If it is ever found stored in organization_commercial_acceptances, I-T4-4 has been defeated and the search_path pin is not holding. PREMEASURED: with the pin removed AND the function owner holding USAGE on the shadow schema, this value WAS accepted and stored (authority P7B); with the pin restored the identical attack was refused (P7C). It must never appear in a green run.

An acceptance row naming ORG_B attempted under ORG_A's identity context. It must be refused in BOTH arms of the isolation proof and must never be found stored: by the repaired trigger with SQLSTATE 23514 while the trigger is enabled (N-02), and by RLS alone with SQLSTATE 42501 while the trigger is disabled by the owner (RLS-01). The two arms exist because a repaired trigger refuses FIRST and would otherwise shadow the RLS wall entirely.

negative_controls.description: STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. SPOOFED ACTOR: an INSERT whose accepted_by_user_id is a subject other than the authenticated one is REFUSED (I-T4-6). Note the layer: with the trigger repaired this refusal comes from the TRIGGER, not RLS -- RLS-01 is the control that proves the wall underneath.

mutation_controls.description: STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. Remove SECURITY DEFINER from the trigger function (keeping everything else). EXPECTED RED: P-01 fails with 42501 permission denied for SCHEMA AUTH raised inside the PL/pgSQL body, and FN-01 fails. UNIQUE ANCHOR: P-01 with an auth-schema error. FALSIFIABILITY IS PREMEASURED, not hypothetical -- this is exactly the pre-remediation state the authority writer observed (authority P1C).

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. Remove SET search_path = public, keeping SECURITY DEFINER. EXPECTED RED: FN-02. SEMANTIC ARM REQUIRED AND ITS PRECONDITION IS BINDING: a catalog-shape assertion alone is weak, and a naive semantic arm SILENTLY PASSES for the wrong reason. PREMEASURED (authority P7A vs P7B): search_path resolution skips schemas the EFFECTIVE user lacks USAGE on, and inside a DEFINER function that user is the OWNER -- so the shadowing attack fails harmlessly unless the OWNER can see the attacker-writable schema. The semantic arm must therefore grant the owner USAGE on the shadow schema, then assert that SENTINEL_FORGED_CONTENT_DIGEST IS accepted without the pin and REFUSED with it. UNIQUE ANCHOR: FN-02 plus the sentinel landing in the table.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. Weaken the accepted_by_user_id equality -- either relax IS DISTINCT FROM or drop the v_actor IS NULL arm of the guard at 0072:200. EXPECTED RED: N-01 for the equality half, N-05 for the NULL half. UNIQUE ANCHOR: N-01 and N-05 together; the two-arm split exists precisely so a mutation that touches only one arm cannot hide behind the other.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. Remove the role-in-org invariant (the current_user_role_in_org exact-equality guard at 0072:209-214). EXPECTED RED: N-04 and N-02. UNIQUE ANCHOR: N-04, which no other mutation in this table turns RED.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. Re-home the function to an owner lacking dependent-table reach in the test substrate. EXPECTED RED: P-01 and FN-04. THE OBSERVED ERROR IS THE TABLE ONE, NOT AN AUTH ONE -- PREMEASURED (authority P5A/P5B): 42501 permission denied for table legal_instrument_versions at PL/pgSQL line 5, and it REMAINS the table error even after that owner is granted auth USAGE. A control written to expect an auth-schema error under this mutation will not fire. UNIQUE ANCHOR: FN-04 with a table-reach failure.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. GRANT EXECUTE on the trigger function to a runtime role. EXPECTED RED: PRIV-05. UNIQUE ANCHOR: PRIV-05 alone. The baseline is genuinely falsifiable -- PREMEASURED (authority P3B) that the positive insert succeeds while the runtime holds no EXECUTE, so the privilege is demonstrably unnecessary rather than merely absent.

STATUS=FUTURE_MATERIALIZATION. Restore the fixture grant GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO uellix_writer (tests/postgres/organization-commercial-acceptance-fixtures.ts:125). EXPECTED RED: PRIV-02 (and PRIV-01 through the inherited membership). UNIQUE ANCHOR: PRIV-02. THIS MUTATION GUARDS THE INTEGRITY OF THE WHOLE SUITE, not one assertion -- PREMEASURED (authority P8A/P8B) that restoring it makes even the UNREMEDIATED INVOKER function insert successfully, which is exactly how the defect survived the L1 unit's own green Real-PG suite.
